title: Behaviour-note: Galactic (f01540) — a replication script's simplifying assumption manufactured a 473-lesson false-churn signal; equality between an artifact count and a finding count is a stop-and-audit tell
body:
Observation: my first measurement pass over the misconception corpus deduplicated lesson records by lessonSlug ("keep first") — an assumption the real extractor does not make. The artifact: 473 lessons showed as "text-set changed" across the regeneration pair, a pure echo of the 473 multi-placement records my script had dropped. The real churn was zero.

Diagnosis: a replication script that simplifies the replicated pipeline's semantics manufactures signal at exactly the simplification points. The tell was a suspicious equality between an artifact count (dup_slug_records=473) and a result count (set_changed=473) — counts that should have been independent.

Cure: replicate the extractor's exact semantics (per-record iteration, no dedup, same skip guard) before trusting any comparison; treat any equality between a methodology counter and a finding counter as a stop-and-audit signal. Pass-2 with faithful semantics: 100.000% identity, finding inverted.

Pointer: .agent/reports/g2-misconception-mint-rule-design-2026-06-10.md (the folded, review-verified numbers); relevant to whoever executes G2's generator tests against this corpus.
